title: Pre-Registered Predictions for the Energy-Flow Cosmology Model Against the Rubin Observatory LSST DP2 Cosmic Shear Dataset
description: This pre-registration seals quantitative, falsifiable predictions of the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) model for Rubin Observatory LSST Data Preview 2 (DP2) cosmic shear. It forecasts an ~8–10% large-scale lensing enhancement and S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015 driven by a gravitational slip η ≈ 1.10, and specifies explicit falsification thresholds against the forthcoming DP2 measurements.

mu_param.description: Effective modification to the Newtonian clustering potential in EFC, activated by the regime gate G(a).

Sigma_param.description: Effective modification to the Weyl (lensing) potential in EFC, controlling lensing amplitude.

eta_slip.description: Gravitational slip (ratio of lensing to Newtonian potentials) predicted to be > 1 at late times in EFC.

S8_def.description: Shear amplitude parameter used to summarize cosmic shear constraints.

xi_plus_ratio.description: Approximate scaling of the large-scale shear correlation enhancement in EFC relative to ΛCDM.

cl_enhancement.description: Predicted EFC enhancement of the convergence power spectrum on large angular scales relevant for DP2.

key_results.main_finding: Sealed EFC predictions for Rubin LSST DP2: S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015 and ~8% enhancement of ξ+(θ) at 20′–300′ driven by η ≈ 1.10, with explicit >2σ falsification thresholds.
datasets_used: Rubin Observatory LSST DP2 cosmic shear (planned)
DESI DR2 BAO prior on Ωm (sealed, as referenced)

sealed_predictions.statement: Cosmic shear amplitude S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015 (EFC KC4), implying ΔS8 ≈ +0.015 relative to ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Rubin LSST DP2 shear-only or joint 3×2pt S8 measurement.

sealed_predictions.statement: Large-scale shear correlation enhancement: ξ+^EFC(θ)/ξ+^ΛCDM(θ) ≈ Σ^2(z_eff) ≈ 1.08 for θ ∈ [20′, 300′].
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DP2 tomographic ξ±(θ) with standard scale cuts and covariance.

sealed_predictions.statement: Lensing modification Σ(z_eff≈0.65) = 1.04 ± 0.02 and convergence power enhancement ΔC_ℓ/C_ℓ ≈ +0.08 at ℓ ≲ 300.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DP2 C_ℓ^κκ or Hankel-transformed ξ± with validated systematics treatment.

sealed_predictions.statement: Gravitational slip η(z=0) = 1.10 ± 0.05 (KC4 constraint), with µ(z_eff≈0.65) = 0.97 ± 0.03.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint (µ, Σ) constraints from DP2 shear combined with spectroscopic clustering/RSD.

sealed_predictions.statement: If ξ+_obs(θ)/ξ+_ΛCDM(θ) < 1.00 at θ > 30′ with >2σ significance, the predicted large-scale enhancement is excluded.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DP2 ξ+(θ) comparison to ΛCDM baseline with official covariance.

kill_criteria: KC1: If DP2 measures S8 < 0.820 at >2σ confidence, the KC4 EFC lensing sector (η ≈ 1.10) is ruled out.
KC2: If ξ+_obs(θ)/ξ+_ΛCDM(θ) < 1.00 at θ > 30′ with >2σ significance, the predicted large-scale lensing enhancement is falsified.
KC3: If a joint (µ, Σ) analysis (DP2 shear + spectroscopic data) is inconsistent with η > 1.05 at >2σ, the gravitational slip prediction is falsified.
KC4: If Σ(z_eff≈0.65) ≤ 1.00 at >2σ (i.e., no positive lensing enhancement), the EFC large-scale lensing prediction is falsified.

related_packages.role: Parent sealed pre-registration covering BAO/RSD/growth constraints (KC4 level).

ledger_impact.holistic_analysis: This paper seals quantitative, falsifiable EFC predictions for the Rubin LSST DP2 cosmic shear dataset, directly targeting the KC4 lensing/gravitational-slip sector. It does not close KC4 — it arms it with explicit pre-registered thresholds (S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015, η ≈ 1.10, ~8% ξ+ enhancement) that will be adjudicated when DP2 data drops (expected July–September 2026). This is the weak-lensing companion to the BAO/RSD/growth sealed prediction (DOI 32010399), completing the Stage-IV pre-registration coverage across both clustering and lensing sectors.
graph_insights: This paper is currently an orphan node in the graph (no 1-2 hop connections found), indicating it should be linked to the parent pre-registration (DOI 32010399), the KC4 constraint node, and the EFC parameter archive (DOI 31876324) mentioned in the theoretical framework section.

The concepts 'S8', 'gravitational slip', and 'modified gravity' create natural bridge edges to future Euclid and DES Y6 weak-lensing nodes — when those datasets arrive, the same sealed η ≈ 1.10 prediction can be tested independently without requiring a new pre-registration.
No existing validation tests share observables with this paper, confirming these four tests are genuinely new pipeline entries rather than duplicates.

implicit_consequences: EFC now has sealed pre-registrations covering BOTH the clustering sector (BAO/RSD/fσ8 via DOI 32010399) AND the lensing sector (cosmic shear/S8/η via this paper) — meaning every major Stage-IV observable channel has a locked, falsifiable EFC prediction before data.

The η ≈ 1.10 prediction creates a direct tension test with Planck ΛCDM (η = 1.00 exactly), meaning any Rubin DP2 measurement of η will simultaneously test ΛCDM and EFC — the two models make non-overlapping predictions at the 2σ level.

The frozen µ(z_eff≈0.65) = 0.97 ± 0.03 value implies EFC predicts slightly suppressed clustering growth relative to ΛCDM at the same redshift where lensing is enhanced — this anti-correlated µ-Σ signature is a unique EFC fingerprint that generic modified gravity models do not generically produce.

The explicit dependence on the regime gate function G(a) activating at a ≳ 0.3 ties the lensing prediction to the same transition epoch constrained by BAO/RSD tests, creating an internal consistency web: if the transition epoch shifts under DESI DR2 constraints, the lensing predictions shift in a calculable, correlated way.
The four pipeline tests added here bring the total pipeline count from 18 to 22, strengthening the pre-data coverage before the Q3 2026 data wave.

A future EFCLASS Boltzmann solver (theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver gap) would allow direct computation of C_ℓ^κκ from first principles rather than the µ-Σ parameterisation, providing an independent cross-check on P3.
